title: A minimizing-movement framework for geometric gradient flows with admissible tangential motion
summary: We develop a minimizing-movement framework for parametric finite element approximations of geometric gradient flows with admissible tangential motion. At each time step, the discrete variational problem combines a metric dissipation term for the normal displacement with a surface Dirichlet energy. The metric determines the normal geometric evolution: the $L^2(Γ)$ metric gives mean curvature flow, while the $H^{-1}(Γ)$ metric gives surface diffusion flow.
